items.note: ok the KITCHEN. double-height barrel-vaulted ceiling, a fireplace next to the breakfast table, AND a wine cellar with a tasting room downstairs. 2.3 acres. i can't.
the biggest thing on the scarsdale new-listings page rn. six bedrooms. just putting it in front of you.
bronxville!! five bedrooms, would look SO good with a wreath on the door.
5.5 bathrooms for 5 bedrooms. nobody in this house is ever waiting for a shower.
more bathrooms than bedrooms AGAIN. scarsdale has a thing and i respect it.

items.title: "Two Fishes" is everywhere
items.body: it's a deadpan clip of Corbin from Love Island USA season 8 (people literally call him CorbinGPT) and everyone is lip-syncing it to defend the most unhinged opinions with total confidence. the worse the take, the better it does.

items.title: everyone is doing the Kylie hip pop
items.body: people are recreating Kylie Jenner's runway moment, the little hip pop and the slightly nervous turn, set to JADE's "Angel of My Dreams." glam but awkward. it's working on literally any outfit.

items.title: "stop the wedding, but…" confessions
items.body: photo carousels that open with "stop the wedding, but…" and then reveal a wedding regret or a weirdly specific memory. people are being SO honest. very good scroll.

items.title: the halloween costume of the year is not close
items.body: KPop Demon Hunters. Rumi, Mira and Zoey costumes are officially licensed now and they are all over the costume reveals. expect a lot of them at your door friday.

items.title: gen alpha's obsession is a minecraft horror movie
items.body: it's called "Verity" (NOT the colleen hoover one). it's an hour-long minecraft horror video by a youtuber called ThatMob, and the scary thing is a yellow smiley face that's basically an AI assistant. very on the nose.

items.title: 13–15 year olds are weirdly optimistic about dating
items.body: Match Group surveyed young teens: only 20% have been in a relationship (gen z was 56% at that age), 64% think you should be friends first, and 84% think their future is bright. cute?? honestly cute.

items.title: everything is "-maxxing" now
items.body: looksmaxxing, sleepmaxxing, personalitymaxxing. it just means optimizing something to the max. looksmaxxing officially made it into Merriam-Webster, and "lowkenuinely" is one of the favorites for their word of the year.

items.title: gen z is letting AI do the shopping
items.body: 80% of gen z used AI to buy something in the last three months. but 45% also say online recommendations limit what they're "allowed" to like. so they use it and resent it. relatable.
